question: Service 有哪些类型?
context:
[S1][schema][K8s schema] Service · spec.type
Service 的字段 spec.type:type determines how the Service is exposed. Defaults to ClusterIP. Valid options are ExternalName, ClusterIP, NodePort, and LoadBalancer. "ClusterIP" allocates a cluster-internal IP address for load-balancing to endpoints. Endpoints are determined by the selector or if that is not specified, by manual construction of an Endpoints object or EndpointSlice objects. If clusterIP is "None", no virtual IP is allocated and the endpoints are published as a set of endpoints rather than a virtual IP. "NodePort" builds on ClusterIP and allocates a port on every node which routes to the same endpoints as the clusterIP. "LoadBalancer" builds on NodePort and creates an external load-balancer (if supported in the current cloud) which routes to the same endpoints as the clusterIP. "ExternalName" aliases this service to the specified externalName. Several other fields do not apply to ExternalName services. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/#publishing-services-service-types

Possible enum values:
 - `"ClusterIP"` means a service will only be accessible inside the cluster, via the cluster IP.
 - `"ExternalName"` means a service consists of only a reference to an external name that kubedns or equivalent will return as a CNAME record, with no exposing or proxying of any pods involved.
 - `"LoadBalancer"` means a service will be exposed via an external load balancer (if the cloud provider supports it), in addition to 'NodePort' type.
 - `"NodePort"` means a service will be exposed on one port of every node, in addition to 'ClusterIP' type.。类型 string。可选值 ClusterIP / ExternalName / LoadBalancer / NodePort

[S2][schema][K8s schema] Service · spec.selector
Service 的字段 spec.selector:Route service traffic to pods with label keys and values matching this selector. If empty or not present, the service is assumed to have an external process managing its endpoints, which Kubernetes will not modify. Only applies to types ClusterIP, NodePort, and LoadBalancer. Ignored if type is ExternalName. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/。类型 object

[S3][schema][K8s schema] Service · kind
Service 的字段 kind:Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents. Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to. Cannot be updated. In CamelCase. More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds。类型 string
answer: Service 的类型有：`ClusterIP`、`ExternalName`、`LoadBalancer`、`NodePort`。

[S2][schema][K8s schema] PodDisruptionBudget · spec.maxUnavailable

Example: when this is set to 30%, the old ReplicaSet can be scaled down to 70% of desired pods immediately when the rolling update starts. Once new pods are ready, old ReplicaSet can be scaled down further, followed by scaling up the new ReplicaSet, ensuring that the total number of pods available at all times during the update is at least 70% of desired pods.

question: Pod 镜像拉取策略怎么配?
context:
[S1][schema][K8s schema] Pod · spec.containers.imagePullPolicy
Pod 的字段 spec.containers.imagePullPolicy:Image pull policy. One of Always, Never, IfNotPresent. Defaults to Always if :latest tag is specified, or IfNotPresent otherwise. Cannot be updated. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/images#updating-images

Possible enum values:
 - `"Always"` means that kubelet always attempts to pull the latest image. Container will fail If the pull fails.
 - `"IfNotPresent"` means that kubelet pulls if the image isn't present on disk. Container will fail if the image isn't present and the pull fails.
 - `"Never"` means that kubelet never pulls an image, but only uses a local image. Container will fail if the image isn't present。类型 string。可选值 Always / IfNotPresent / Never

[S2][schema][K8s schema] Pod · spec.initContainers.imagePullPolicy
Pod 的字段 spec.initContainers.imagePullPolicy:Image pull policy. One of Always, Never, IfNotPresent. Defaults to Always if :latest tag is specified, or IfNotPresent otherwise. Cannot be updated. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/images#updating-images

Possible enum values:
 - `"Always"` means that kubelet always attempts to pull the latest image. Container will fail If the pull fails.
 - `"IfNotPresent"` means that kubelet pulls if the image isn't present on disk. Container will fail if the image isn't present and the pull fails.
 - `"Never"` means that kubelet never pulls an image, but only uses a local image. Container will fail if the image isn't present。类型 string。可选值 Always / IfNotPresent / Never

[S3][schema][K8s schema] Pod · spec.volumes.image.pullPolicy
Pod 的字段 spec.volumes.image.pullPolicy:Policy for pulling OCI objects. Possible values are: Always: the kubelet always attempts to pull the reference. Container creation will fail If the pull fails. Never: the kubelet never pulls the reference and only uses a local image or artifact. Container creation will fail if the reference isn't present. IfNotPresent: the kubelet pulls if the reference isn't already present on disk. Container creation will fail if the reference isn't present and the pull fails. Defaults to Always if :latest tag is specified, or IfNotPresent otherwise.

Possible enum values:
 - `"Always"` means that kubelet always attempts to pull the latest image. Container will fail If the pull fails.
 - `"IfNotPresent"` means that kubelet pulls if the image isn't present on disk. Container will fail if the image isn't present and the pull fails.
 - `"Never"` means that kubelet never pulls an image, but only uses a local image. Container will fail if the image isn't present。类型 string。可选值 Always / IfNotPresent / Never
answer:
您可以通过以下字段配置 Pod 的镜像拉取策略：

- **普通容器**：`spec.containers.imagePullPolicy`  
- **初始化容器**：`spec.initContainers.imagePullPolicy`  
- **卷（OCI 对象）**：`spec.volumes.image.pullPolicy`

这三个字段的取值均为枚举，可选值如下：
- `Always`：kubelet 始终尝试拉取最新镜像，拉取失败则容器启动失败。
- `IfNotPresent`：若本地不存在镜像则拉取，拉取失败则容器启动失败。
- `Never`：仅使用本地镜像，从不拉取，本地不存在则容器启动失败。

**默认值**：如果镜像标签指定为 `:latest`，则默认使用 `Always`；否则默认使用 `IfNotPresent`。该字段在 Pod 创建后不可更新。

question: 平台对 Deployment 的资源限制有什么规范?
context:
[S1][policy][组织策略] 平台规范 · Deployment · spec.template.spec.containers.resources.limits
[平台规范] 生产环境 Deployment 容器必须设置 resources.limits(cpu/memory)。级别:required。适用:prod。理由:防止单容器耗尽节点资源,保障多租户稳定性。(组织策略/平台规范,非 K8s 官方强制)

[S2][policy][组织策略] 平台规范 · Deployment · spec.template.spec.containers.resources.requests
[平台规范] 生产环境 Deployment 容器必须设置 resources.requests(cpu/memory)。级别:required。适用:prod。理由:无 requests 调度器无法合理分配,易引发节点超卖。(组织策略/平台规范,非 K8s 官方强制)

[S3][schema][K8s schema] Deployment · spec.template.spec.resources.limits
Deployment 的字段 spec.template.spec.resources.limits:Limits describes the maximum amount of compute resources allowed. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/。类型 object
answer:
根据提供的文档，平台对 Deployment 的资源限制有以下组织规范：

- **必须设置 `resources.limits`（cpu 和 memory）**：适用于生产环境（`prod`），级别为 required（必需）。理由是防止单容器耗尽节点资源，保障多租户稳定性 [S1]。
- **必须设置 `resources.requests`（cpu 和 memory）**：同样适用于生产环境，级别为 required。理由是若无 requests，调度器无法合理分配，易引发节点超卖 [S2]。

以上均为平台组织策略（非 K8s 官方强制）。在 K8s schema 层面，`spec.template.spec.resources.limits` 字段是合法的对象类型，允许填写 [S3]，但平台规范强制要求在生产环境中必须填写。

human.note: 答案正确标注资源限制为组织策略,并用 schema chunk 支撑字段层事实

"ClusterIP" allocates a cluster-internal IP address for load-balancing to endpoints. Endpoints are determined by the selector or if that is not specified, by manual construction of an Endpoints object or EndpointSlice objects. If clusterIP is "None", no virtual IP is allocated and the endpoints are published as a set of endpoints rather than a virtual IP. "NodePort" builds on ClusterIP and allocates a port on every node which routes to the same endpoints as the clusterIP. "LoadBalancer" builds on NodePort and creates an external load-balancer (if supported in the current cloud) which routes to the same endpoints as the clusterIP. "ExternalName" aliases this service to the specified externalName. Several other fields do not apply to ExternalName services. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/#publishing-services-service-types

Possible enum values:
 - `"ClusterIP"` means a service will only be accessible inside the cluster, via the cluster IP.
 - `"ExternalName"` means a service consists of only a reference to an external name that kubedns or equivalent will return as a CNAME record, with no exposing or proxying of any pods involved.
 - `"LoadBalancer"` means a service will be exposed via an external load balancer (if the cloud provider supports it), in addition to 'NodePort' type.
